_readme: Golden query fixture for the client-MiniSearch vs worker-SQLite search-parity gate (T4-2). Each entry: id (stable key into the baseline snapshot), category, query (raw user text), optional vendors (vendor-chip filter, mirrors the production union filter), and note (why this query was chosen). Consumed by search-parity.golden.test.ts. Queries are chosen to exercise real usage across scripts, lengths, karaoke numbers, vendor filters, and known-divergent paths (numbers / Hangul initials / n-gram recall exist only on the worker path). Adding/removing a query requires regenerating the baseline snapshot (see search-parity.golden.test.ts header).
